At v3.0.0: finalizeUpgrade_v3(): `_checkContractVersion(2); _setContractVersion(3);`. At v2.0.0: `_setContractVersion(2)` in _initialize_v2, finalizeUpgrade_v2 `_checkContractVersion(0)`. facts.value: 'Lido V3 introduces external shares, which represent stETH minted against stVault collateral.'
facts.note: Docs continue: external shares are 'tracked separately from core pool shares to keep the core pool solvent while allowing overcollateralized minting'; methods getExternalShares(), getExternalEther(), getMaxExternalRatioBP(); totalPooledEther = buffered + CL validators balance + CL pending balance + deposited-since-report + 'External ether (backing external/stVault shares, tracked separately via VaultHub)'. LIP-31 (https://github.com/lidofinance/lido-improvement-proposals/blob/develop/LIPS/lip-31.md), status 'Implemented': 'This proposal introduces an over-collateralized accounting system for stETH, enabling the token to be backed by ether supplied outside the Lido Core pool while preserving full fungibility and 1:1 redeemability'; 'stETH share rate is now calculated based on internal ether and internal shares'. Integration guide: 'stETH minted via stVaults is the same canonical stETH token'.

`pragma solidity 0.4.24; contract StETH is IERC20, Pausable`. Path confirmed via https://api.github.com/repos/lidofinance/core/git/trees/v4.0.1?recursive=1. Regular state variables in source order: `mapping (address => uint256) private shares;` then `mapping (address => mapping (address => uint256)) private allowances;` — no others. Constants: INITIAL_TOKEN_HOLDER = 0xdead, INFINITE_ALLOWANCE = ~uint256(0), UINT128_MAX = ~uint128(0), UINT128_HIGH_MASK = ~uint256(0) << 128.

`pragma solidity 0.4.24; contract Lido is Versioned, StETHPermit, AragonApp`. NatSpec: 'Liquid staking pool implementation. Lido is an Ethereum liquid staking protocol solving the problem of frozen staked ether on the Consensus Layer being unavailable for transfers and DeFi on the Execution Layer.' StETHPermit (contracts/0.4.24/StETHPermit.sol): `contract StETHPermit is IERC2612, StETH`, adds one regular var `mapping(address => uint256) internal noncesByAddress;`.

v4.0.1 verbatim: `function getPooledEthByShares(uint256 _sharesAmount) public view returns (uint256) { require(_sharesAmount < UINT128_MAX, "SHARES_TOO_LARGE"); return (_sharesAmount * _getShareRateNumerator()) / _getShareRateDenominator(); }` with `_getShareRateNumerator() { return _getTotalPooledEther(); }` and `_getShareRateDenominator() { return _getTotalShares(); }`. Inverse: `getSharesByPooledEth(_ethAmount) = (_ethAmount * _getShareRateDenominator()) / _getShareRateNumerator()`. v2.0.0 verbatim (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lidofinance/core/v2.0.0/contracts/0.4.24/StETH.sol): `return _sharesAmount.mul(_getTotalPooledEther()).div(_getTotalShares());`. Storage comment above `shares`: balance 'equals to: shares[account] * _getTotalPooledEther() / _getTotalShares()'. `_getTotalPooledEther()` is declared abstract in StETH.sol (`function _getTotalPooledEther() internal view returns (uint256);`) and implemented in Lido.sol.

facts.value: slot 0x6038150aecaa250d524370a0fdcdec13f2690e0723eaf277f41d7cae26b359e6 = keccak256("lido.StETH.totalAndExternalShares"); low 128 bits = totalShares, high 128 bits = externalShares
facts.note: Verbatim: `bytes32 internal constant TOTAL_SHARES_POSITION_LOW128 = 0x6038150aecaa250d524370a0fdcdec13f2690e0723eaf277f41d7cae26b359e6;` // keccak256("lido.StETH.totalAndExternalShares"); comment: '@dev Since version 3, high 128 bits can be used to store the external shares from Lido contract'. `_getTotalShares() { return TOTAL_SHARES_POSITION_LOW128.getLowUint128(); }`; `_mintShares`/`_burnShares` write `TOTAL_SHARES_POSITION_LOW128.setLowUint128(newTotalShares)`. Lido.sol aliases it: `TOTAL_AND_EXTERNAL_SHARES_POSITION = TOTAL_SHARES_POSITION_LOW128` with layout comment '|----- 128 bit -----|------ 128 bit -------| | external shares | total shares |'; `_getExternalShares() { return TOTAL_AND_EXTERNAL_SHARES_POSITION.getHighUint128(); }`. Same slot present at v3.0.0. Hash verified locally with keccak256 (pycryptodome); matches source comment.

facts.value: slot 0xe3b4b636e601189b5f4c6742edf2538ac12bb61ed03e6da26949d69838fa447e = keccak256("lido.StETH.totalShares") (full uint256), used until the V3 upgrade
facts.note: Verbatim v2.0.0: `bytes32 internal constant TOTAL_SHARES_POSITION = 0xe3b4b636e601189b5f4c6742edf2538ac12bb61ed03e6da26949d69838fa447e;` // keccak256("lido.StETH.totalShares"); `_getTotalShares() { return TOTAL_SHARES_POSITION.getStorageUint256(); }`. Migrated in Lido.sol v3.0.0 `_migrateStorage_v2_to_v3()` (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lidofinance/core/v3.0.0/contracts/0.4.24/Lido.sol): `bytes32 TOTAL_SHARES_POSITION = keccak256("lido.StETH.totalShares"); uint256 totalShares = TOTAL_SHARES_POSITION.getStorageUint256(); assert(totalShares > 0); TOTAL_AND_EXTERNAL_SHARES_POSITION.setLowUint128(totalShares); TOTAL_SHARES_POSITION.setStorageUint256(0);`. A storage-tracking indexer must switch slots at the finalizeUpgrade_v3 transaction (old slot is zeroed). Hash verified locally.

facts.value: mapping (address => uint256) private shares; regular Solidity mapping — inferred slot index 0, so shares[holder] lives at keccak256(abi.encode(holder, uint256(0)))
facts.note: Inheritance analysis for `Lido is Versioned, StETHPermit, AragonApp`: Versioned (contracts/0.4.24/utils/Versioned.sol) declares only constants; Pausable (contracts/0.4.24/utils/Pausable.sol) only `ACTIVE_FLAG_POSITION = 0x644132c4ddd5bb6f0655d5fe2870dcec7870e6be4758890f366b83441f9fdece` // keccak256("lido.Pausable.activeFlag"); IERC20/IERC2612 are interfaces; StETH declares `shares` then `allowances`; StETHPermit adds `noncesByAddress`; @aragon/os 4.4.0 AragonApp/AppStorage/Initializable/Petrifiable/ReentrancyGuard use only unstructured-storage constants (KERNEL_POSITION 0x4172f0f7..., APP_ID_POSITION 0xd625496..., INITIALIZATION_BLOCK_POSITION 0xebb05b38..., REENTRANCY_MUTEX_POSITION 0xe855346...). Hence expected layout: slot 0 = shares, slot 1 = allowances, slot 2 = noncesByAddress. Not yet confirmed against a compiled storage-layout artifact (see open_questions). Writes: `_transferShares`: `shares[_sender] = currentSenderShares.sub(_sharesAmount); shares[_recipient] = shares[_recipient].add(_sharesAmount);`; `_mintShares`: `shares[_recipient] = shares[_recipient].add(_sharesAmount)`; `_burnShares`: `shares[_account] = accountShares.sub(_sharesAmount)`.

facts.value: event TokenRebased(uint256 indexed reportTimestamp, uint256 timeElapsed, uint256 preTotalShares, uint256 preTotalEther, uint256 postTotalShares, uint256 postTotalEther, uint256 sharesMintedAsFees); topic0 = 0xff08c3ef606d198e316ef5b822193c489965899eb4e3c248cea1a4626c3eda50
facts.note: Declared in Lido.sol (not StETH.sol); identical declaration at v2.0.0, v3.0.0 and v4.0.1. Emitted by the stETH proxy 0xae7ab965... In V3+/V4 it is emitted from `emitTokenRebase(uint256 _reportTimestamp, uint256 _timeElapsed, uint256 _preTotalShares, uint256 _preTotalEther, uint256 _postTotalShares, uint256 _postTotalEther, uint256 _postInternalShares, uint256 _postInternalEther, uint256 _sharesMintedAsFees) external { _auth(_accounting()); ... }` called by Accounting.handleOracleReport; in V2 it was emitted inside Lido.handleOracleReport (auth `msg.sender == contracts.accountingOracle`). postTotalEther/postTotalShares give the post-report share rate directly. topic0 computed locally via keccak256 of the canonical signature. Other share events (StETH.sol): `TransferShares(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 sharesValue)` topic0 0x9d9c909296d9c674451c0c24f02cb64981eb3b727f99865939192f880a755dcb; `SharesBurnt(address indexed account, uint256 preRebaseTokenAmount, uint256 postRebaseTokenAmount, uint256 sharesAmount)` topic0 0x8b2a1e1ad5e0578c3dd82494156e985dade827a87c573b5c1c7716a32162ad64. Integration guide: rebase does not 'emit Transfer() on rebase as ERC-20 standard requires' (https://docs.lido.fi/guides/lido-tokens-integration-guide).

facts.value: yes — getExternalShares(), getExternalEther(), getMaxExternalRatioBP(), _getExternalEther(), mintExternalShares(), burnExternalShares() present in Lido.sol at v3.0.0, v4.0.1 and master
facts.note: Verbatim v4.0.1: `function _getTotalPooledEther() internal view returns (uint256) { uint256 internalEther = _getInternalEther(); return internalEther.add(_getExternalEther(internalEther)); }`; `function _getExternalEther(uint256 _internalEther) internal view returns (uint256) { (uint256 totalShares, uint256 externalShares) = _getTotalAndExternalShares(); uint256 internalShares = totalShares - externalShares; return (externalShares * _internalEther) / internalShares; }`; `function getExternalShares() external view returns (uint256) { return _getExternalShares(); }`; `function getExternalEther() external view returns (uint256) { return _getExternalEther(_getInternalEther()); }`. `mintExternalShares(address _recipient, uint256 _amountOfShares)`: `_auth(_vaultHub()); ... require(_amountOfShares <= _getMaxMintableExternalShares(), "EXTERNAL_BALANCE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED"); _setExternalShares(_getExternalShares() + _amountOfShares); _mintShares(_recipient, _amountOfShares); ... emit ExternalSharesMinted(_recipient, _amountOfShares);`. `burnExternalShares(uint256 _amountOfShares)`: `_auth(_vaultHub()); ... _setExternalShares(externalShares - _amountOfShares); _burnShares(msg.sender, _amountOfShares); ... emit ExternalSharesBurnt(_amountOfShares);`. Events: `ExternalSharesMinted(address indexed receiver, uint256 amountOfShares)` topic0 0xee473f96486a2f4b93ccb6729f121223e96975db6e0d6a5ef01f56477e3eab3b; `ExternalSharesBurnt(uint256 amountOfShares)` topic0 0xad21467656c56eb8c99f7916faa12f7a657a04d8802100acec62e92451ac5606 (computed locally). Max external ratio packed with locator: `LOCATOR_AND_MAX_EXTERNAL_RATIO_POSITION = 0xd92bc31601d11a10411d08f59b7146d8a5915af253cde25f8e66b67beb4be223` // keccak256("lido.Lido.lidoLocatorAndMaxExternalRatio") (verified locally). Because external ether is defined as externalShares * internalEther / internalShares, share rate = internalEther/internalShares = totalPooledEther/totalShares, so balanceOf math is unchanged by external shares.

Verbatim: `function _getInternalEther() internal view returns (uint256) { (uint256 bufferedEther, uint256 depositedPostReport) = _getBufferedEtherAndDepositedPostReport(); (uint256 clValidatorsBalance, uint256 clPendingBalance) = _getClValidatorsBalanceAndClPendingBalance(); return bufferedEther.add(clValidatorsBalance).add(clPendingBalance).add(depositedPostReport); }`. Storage: `BUFFERED_ETHER_AND_DEPOSITED_POST_REPORT_POSITION = 0x81a11fa1111afa59b50051f60ccf604a39d96acb484dc467ad8eadb4a63f0a5f` // keccak256("lido.Lido.bufferedEtherAndDepositedPostReport"); `STAKING_STATE_POSITION = 0xa3678de4a579be090bed1177e0a24f77cc29d181ac22fd7688aca344d8938015` // keccak256("lido.Lido.stakeLimit"). v3.0.0 form: `bufferedEther.add(clBalance).add(transientEther)` with `transientEther = (depositedValidators - clValidators) * DEPOSIT_SIZE`, slots `BUFFERED_ETHER_AND_DEPOSITED_VALIDATORS_POSITION = 0xa84c096ee27e195f25d7b6c7c2a03229e49f1a2a5087e57ce7d7127707942fe3` // keccak256("lido.Lido.bufferedEtherAndDepositedValidators"). v2.0.0 form: `_getBufferedEther().add(CL_BALANCE_POSITION.getStorageUint256()).add(_getTransientBalance())`, slots `BUFFERED_ETHER_POSITION = 0xed310af23f61f96daefbcd140b306c0bdbf8c178398299741687b90e794772b0` // keccak256("lido.Lido.bufferedEther"), `DEPOSITED_VALIDATORS_POSITION = 0xe6e35175eb53fc006520a2a9c3e9711a7c00de6ff2c32dd31df8c5a24cac1b5c` // keccak256("lido.Lido.depositedValidators"), `LIDO_LOCATOR_POSITION = 0x9ef78dff90f100ea94042bd00ccb978430524befc391d3e510b5f55ff3166df7` // keccak256("lido.Lido.lidoLocator"). All hashes verified locally. v4 migration `_migrateStorage_v3_to_v4()` reads the two v3 slots, writes the v4 slots, and zeroes the v3 slots; v3 migration `_migrateStorage_v2_to_v3()` does the same for the v2 slots.

facts.value: CL beacon balance is consensus-layer state; the EL only learns it via the AccountingOracle report, which Accounting.handleOracleReport writes into Lido storage once per report. Current slot: 0x096e465397f38e659238ccd5d5a2c434ced54a63fd8d694045bfb058ab9d8112 = keccak256("lido.Lido.clValidatorsBalanceAndClPendingBalance")
facts.note: Verbatim v4.0.1: `bytes32 internal constant CL_VALIDATORS_BALANCE_AND_CL_PENDING_BALANCE_POSITION = 0x096e465397f38e659238ccd5d5a2c434ced54a63fd8d694045bfb058ab9d8112;` // keccak256("lido.Lido.clValidatorsBalanceAndClPendingBalance"). `function processClStateUpdate(uint256 _reportTimestamp, uint256 _clValidatorsBalance, uint256 _clPendingBalance) external { _whenNotStopped(); _auth(_accounting()); ... _setClValidatorsBalanceAndClPendingBalance(_clValidatorsBalance, _clPendingBalance); emit CLBalancesUpdated(_reportTimestamp, _clValidatorsBalance, _clPendingBalance); }` (NatSpec: 'Replaces validator counting in v3 with direct balance tracking for EIP-7251 support'); event `CLBalancesUpdated(uint256 indexed reportTimestamp, uint256 clValidatorsBalance, uint256 clPendingBalance)` topic0 0xc091cf4d34e62bb075bf8dadd00496528c94b8f3fdec3affd7414840847017d2; `DepositedPostReportUpdated(uint256 depositedPostReport)` topic0 0xd87d7ff193e5d1560bdbe21e4e14d13dde0de4e49a03812517640af0a2d5c42c (computed locally). v3.0.0: `processClStateUpdate(_reportTimestamp, _preClValidators, _reportClValidators, _reportClBalance)` writes `CL_BALANCE_AND_CL_VALIDATORS_POSITION = 0xc36804a03ec742b57b141e4e5d8d3bd1ddb08451fd0f9983af8aaab357a78e2f` // keccak256("lido.Lido.clBalanceAndClValidators") and emits `CLValidatorsUpdated(uint256,uint256,uint256)`. v2.0.0: `_processClStateUpdate` writes `CL_BALANCE_POSITION = 0xa66d35f054e68143c18f32c990ed5cb972bb68a68f500cd2dd3a16bbf3686483` // keccak256("lido.Lido.beaconBalance") and `CL_VALIDATORS_POSITION = 0x9f70001d82b6ef54e9d3725b46581c3eb9ee3aa02b941b6aa54d678a9ca35b10` // keccak256("lido.Lido.beaconValidators"), inside handleOracleReport authorized by `msg.sender == contracts.accountingOracle`. Oracle side (https://docs.lido.fi/contracts/accounting-oracle): report's CL value is 'Sum of balances (validator.balance) of all Lido validators on the Ethereum Consensus Layer, excluding pending deposits, nominated in gwei'; committee reaches quorum via HashConsensus then one member calls submitReportData(); processed by Accounting.handleOracleReport(). Consequence for an EL indexer: validator balance changes/rewards/penalties are NOT visible as EL storage writes between reports; the only EL-observable writes are the per-report slot update plus TokenRebased/CLBalancesUpdated logs, and totalPooledEther (hence every stETH balance) is piecewise-constant between reports except for submits, withdrawals finalization and external share mint/burn.

facts.value: balanceOf = shares[holder] * totalPooledEther / totalShares; changes come from (a) shares writes: Transfer/TransferShares, mint (Submitted, mintExternalShares, fee minting in report), burn (SharesBurnt via Burner, burnExternalShares); (b) totalPooledEther writes: submit()/receive (buffered ether), deposits to validators, per-report processClStateUpdate + collectRewardsAndProcessWithdrawals; (c) totalShares writes at the packed slot
facts.note: Derived from the quoted source. `Submitted(address,uint256,address)` topic0 0x96a25c8ce0baabc1fdefd93e9ed25d8e092a3332f3aa9a41722b5697231d1d1a (computed locally; declared in Lido.sol). getBeaconStat() v4.0.1: `depositedValidators = _getSeedDepositsCount(); ... return (depositedValidators, depositedValidators, clValidatorsBalance.add(clPendingBalance));`. Public wstETH/stETH share rate can be reproduced from TokenRebased(postTotalEther, postTotalShares) without storage reads.

Mainnet enactment blocks/txs for the V2 (contract version 2), V3 (finalizeUpgrade_v3, LIP-31) and V4 (finalizeUpgrade_v4, LIP-35) upgrades were not collected (no RPC allowed). For a Substreams indexer these boundaries can be derived on-chain from `ContractVersionSet(uint256)` logs (topic0 0xfddcded6...) on the stETH proxy, and they determine which storage slots hold totalShares / CL balance / buffered ether (slots change at each upgrade and the old slots are zeroed).

The `shares` mapping slot index (expected 0) is inferred from inheritance-order analysis of Versioned, StETH, StETHPermit, Pausable and @aragon/os 4.4.0 AppStorage/Initializable/Petrifiable/ReentrancyGuard; the remaining Aragon bases (Autopetrified, VaultRecoverable, EVMScriptRunner, ACLSyntaxSugar, TimeHelpers) and Lido.sol's own body were not individually checked for regular state variables. They are more derived than StETH in the layout so would not shift slot 0, but confirm against the compiled storage-layout artifact before relying on keccak256(abi.encode(holder, 0)).

Whether the docs-listed Lido implementation 0x028271E30a695c0527A0C50cA30603feD004cDb0 is compiled from exactly tag v4.0.1 (2da0f48f...) vs v4.0.0 was not verified (docs state 'Lido protocol version: v4.0.1'; v4.0.1 release notes describe LIP-36 NEST artifacts, which may not change Lido.sol).
